title: Make the three Windows timing tests wait on their condition
goal: The Windows job fails only when behaviour is wrong, not when the runner is slow
acceptance: Each of the three tests waits on its condition, or carries a Windows budget with a reason
20 consecutive Windows CI runs of the three tests pass
The browser start timeout has headroom on the CI runner
escalation: A change to the behaviour a test checks goes to a fresh-context review

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13: three test waits and one timeout. Not a measurement.
